Nearby stands the spiral husk of a dead Heartwood tree, once a sacred anchor of Essence and a shield against corruption. 

Without Glint or the clerics who once sustained it, the tree withered.Its fallen canopy and split roots remain as a solemn reminder that divine protection must be earned and can be lost.
